text: The bar chart explicitly illustrates the dramatic variation in the proportion of regular physical exercise participants in our nation between 2018 and 2025.
During this period, the percentage climbed remarkably from 28.5% to approximately 65.2%, reflecting an inspiring shift toward healthier living across all demographics.
A combination of powerful drivers accounts for this noticeable upsurge.
Foremost among them is that accompanied by steady economic growth, Chinese citizens enjoy elevated disposable income and increasingly prioritize physical wellness over mere material acquisition.

Furthermore, extensive government investments in public sports infrastructure—such as municipal jogging tracks and community fitness parks—have significantly lowered the threshold for physical workout.
In addition, social media platforms and fitness applications have popularized active workouts as a trendy and invigorating lifestyle among youngsters.
Health is rightfully recognized as the prerequisite for happiness.
To summarize, this encouraging trend mirrors societal progress and heightened life quality.
It is widely anticipated that regular physical exercise will gain greater momentum in the forthcoming years, ushering in a healthier nation.
